artworks.title: Bellerophon Sets Out against the Chimera
artworks.description: Printed Odyssey of Bellerophon’s Lycian labours: the hero rides out against the Chimera on the quest King Iobates assigned after reading Proetus’ sealed death-letter. Schoolbook myth keeps Iobates the off-stage sender of every Pegasus exploit that follows.

popCulture.title: Iliad VI (Bellerophon and Iobates)
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Glaucus tells how Proetus sent Bellerophon to Lycia with tokens of death, and how Iobates — reading the folded tablet — set the Chimera, Solymi, and Amazons as murderous tests.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca (Iobates and Bellerophon)
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus’ handbook expands Iobates’ lethal hospitality and the eventual marriage of Bellerophon to Philonoe — the Lycian king as judge, would-be killer, and finally father-in-law.
